alex_m: Quick heads-up — kicking off a cross-cloud account provisioning preflight for AcmeLabs org. Goal: create org/project/accounts in AWS/GCP/Azure + request GPU quotas, public IPs, and basic network limits before the sprint starts next week. Who can own which provider?

infra-bot: Reminder: New preflight created: https://redwood.internal/provisioning/ACME-Preflight-2026 (auto)

priya.s: I can take GCP. Quick checklist question: do we want A2 (A100) or use A2 + T4 fallback? region preference?

sam_g: I can own AWS. For AWS we need to request EC2 GPU quota increases (p4/p3a/G5), ENI per instance checks, and Elastic IP soft limits. Also check service quota for "Fargate vCPU" if we plan any hybrid infra.

lee_h: I'll do Azure. Note: some regions have no ND A100 SKUs; might need to pick West US 3 or East US. Also confirm subscription has quota enrollment and billing profile.

alex_m: Priority list: 1) GPU quota per region (target: 8x A100 equiv per region) 2) External IPs (Elastic IPs / Static IPs) 3) VPC subnet IP space and ENI limits 4) IAM + service accounts + KMS 5) Billing export + tags.

priya.s: GCP steps I usually follow: open support case + use quota request template. Example snippet: ```
Project: redwood-acme-prod
Quota: GPUs (A100) us-central1
Requested: 8
Justification: Inference fleet for AcmeLabs, sustained throughput 200 rps
Contact: priya.s@redwood.ai
```

sam_g: AWS quota template we send to support: "Request to increase GPU instance limit (p4d/p3) in us-east-1 to X vCPUs and Y instances. Attach expected monthly hours and cost center." Also ask for EBS throughput increases if using high IO datasets.

lee_h: Azure: open a support request for "GPU quota" + check the subscription's "Compute - Virtual Machines" limits. Also request Public IP quota bump (default 4) and increase in NICs per VM.

priya.s: Networking gotcha: GCP default VPC subnet sizes can run out on /24 clusters. Recommend planning /22 per AZ for worker pools and add route table limits check.

sam_g: AWS FYI — ENI limits scale with instance family, but if we hit account-level attachment limits you'll see pod creation failures. Also remember per-region EIP soft limit (by default 5). Request 50 for initial clusters.

alex_m: Tagging & billing: must include these tags on any provisioned resources: billing:ACME, owner:team-name, environment:prod/staging. Also enable billing export to BigQuery/S3 for chargebacks.

priya.s: Security checklist: create dedicated service accounts for inference runtime, restrict key permissions to KMS decrypt only. Add IAM reviewer: @security-eng.

sam_g: Cost estimate: assuming 8 A100 equiv across 3 regions on-demand = approx $120k/mo. Recommend try reserved or committed use discounts once steady. I'll draft numbers.

lee_h: I'll check Azure SKU availability and post region compatibility matrix here by EOD.

alex_m: Owners: GCP=@priya.s, AWS=@sam_g, Azure=@lee_h. I'll handle org-level billing export + tag enforcement policy. Please post support case IDs in this thread once created. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: Checklist items auto-created:
- Create org/project/account
- Create IAM roles + service accounts
- Request GPU quota per region
- Request public IP quota increases
- Validate VPC/subnet sizing and ENI/NIC limits
- Enable billing export and tags
- Open provider support cases and paste IDs

priya.s: Opened GCP support case: 1726345 — requested 8 A100 in us-central1 and 4 A100 in europe-west1.

sam_g: AWS case opened: 89321 — requested 20 Elastic IPs in us-east-1 and p4d instance limit bump to 8.

lee_h: Azure case opened: 55902 — asking for ND A100 quota in East US and increase Public IPs to 40.

alex_m: Perfect. I'll link the Terraform skeleton next and we can start org IAM reviews tomorrow. Thanks all.

priya.s: ack.

sam_g: ack.
